content.short: FIVA is a TON yield-trading protocol for fixed yields, leveraged yield trading, and liquidity strategies.
content.description: FIVA Protocol brings advanced yield markets to TON. Its site highlights fixed-yield income, leveraged yield trading, liquidity provision without impermanent loss, and reward opportunities for users who want more structured DeFi exposure. Experience advanced DeFi on TON with FIVA Protocol. Fix yields for stable income, trade yield with leverage, and provide liquidity without impermanent loss while earning rewards. FIVA is listed for the financial workflow it supports for traders, liquidity providers, borrowers, stakers, or yield users.
